WITH color_totals AS (
  SELECT p.product_color, SUM(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS invoiced_amount
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili
  JOIN Products AS p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id
  GROUP BY p.product_color
), color_metrics AS (
  SELECT product_color,
         invoiced_amount,
         invoiced_amount / SUM(invoiced_amount) OVER () AS share_of_total,
         AVG(invoiced_amount) OVER () AS per_color_average
  FROM color_totals
)
SELECT AVG(invoiced_amount) AS average_invoiced_amount,
       AVG(share_of_total) AS average_share,
       AVG(invoiced_amount - per_color_average) AS average_amount_above_per_color_average
FROM color_metrics
WHERE invoiced_amount > per_color_average
